features.apiAndChecks: API and verification on every change

q1.q: Does EXEGEZIS change anything on my website?
q1.a: No. It only browses and reads, like a visitor. It doesn’t submit forms or press buttons that change data. What your own website does by itself when it loads is recorded and shown to you.

q2.a: A problem is only marked as verified if it appears in every repetition and its evidence is recorded. What appears only sometimes is shown apart as intermittent, never as a fact.

q3.q: Can I check websites that aren’t mine?
q3.a: Only if you have permission. Before inspecting a domain for the first time we ask you to confirm it, and we respect robots.txt unless you tell us the site is yours.

q4.q: What does the AI do, and what doesn’t it do?
q4.a: The AI proposes: test plans, possible quotes, related terms. It never decides a verdict. Everything it proposes is checked by the engine; an invented quote is discarded.

q5.a: We never see them. You sign in yourself in a browser window and we only keep the session, encrypted. You can delete it whenever you want.

q6.q: Does it work with mobile apps or plugins?
q6.a: Today, with websites. APIs, mobile apps, plugins and desktop applications are on the way, with the same rule: only what can be proven.
